title: TMP Layouts and Dimensions
description: For TTM planners and designers: where every NZGTTM set-out dimension comes from and how to apply it - design speed, sign visibility and spacing, warning distance, exclusion zones, tapers, lane widths, delineation, curves, sight distance and mobile operations - then draw and check a TMD an STMS can set out. Prerequisite: NZGTTM-RA-01.
